paperTitle: Scope Is Not Content: Structural Augmentation of Program Slices for Vulnerability Fix Localization

datasets.name: BigVul
datasets.citation: Fan et al., "A C/C++ Code Vulnerability Dataset with Code Changes and CVE Summaries", MSR 2020

experiments: RQ1 (fix localization: coverage, region-size ratio, 294 CVE pairs)
RQ2 (patch-signature discrimination: coarse vs. srcML-augmented, 294 CVE pairs)
RQ3 (detection: TF-IDF + logistic regression, 5-fold CV, 2500 functions, 1:4 imbalance)
RQ3 baselines (TextCNN, BiGRU, frozen CodeBERT, slice-graph GNN, fine-tuned CodeBERT, CodeBERT+AugWhole fusion)

software.note: Two environments -- see requirements.txt (main) and requirements-codebert.txt (CodeBERT/torch); ABI-incompatible, kept separate.

expectedRuntime: ~1 hour (main-venv scripts: minutes; CodeBERT/torch scripts, especially the fine-tune, are the dominant cost)
